description:
You are an Energy Auditor working on a LEED-EB recertification project for the 4StoreyBuilding. The owner is converting the entire Top Floor (zones starting with T.) from private offices to a high-density call center. You need to update the eQUEST model to reflect this change in occupancy density and metabolic rates.

Task requirements:
1. Locate the 5 Top Floor spaces (T.S31, T.E32, T.N33, T.W34, T.C35) in the Building Shell / Internal Loads module.
2. Update the 'Area / Person' for all 5 spaces to 75 sq ft/person (high density).
3. Update the 'Sensible Heat Gain' (PEOPLE-HG-SENS) for all 5 spaces to 275 BTU/hr.
4. Update the 'Latent Heat Gain' (PEOPLE-HG-LAT) for all 5 spaces to 225 BTU/hr.
5. Run the full annual DOE-2.2 simulation to quantify the impact.
6. Save the project.

No specific UI navigation steps are provided; you must know how to navigate the eQUEST detailed data tree.
